subject: Your {tier_name} member coupon is here
heading: Thank you for staying with us, {guest_first_name}
body_html:
As a {tier_name} member you get a member coupon every membership year.

Your coupon

{coupon_code} – {coupon_discount} off one stay booked on our website, valid until {coupon_valid_until}. Silver coupons apply to stays of 7 or more nights. Enter the code in the price summary when you book; one coupon per booking.

Your other member perks – earlier check-in (Silver) or later check-out (Gold) when the apartment is free – are listed in your account:

{cta_button}

Kind regards,
{business_name}
